summary: Ecopetrol S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) announcing a senior management change: Julio César Herrera Martínez stepped down as Vice President of Commercial and Marketing effective September 15, 2026, by mutual agreement terminating his employment. Graford Santamaría Valbuena, previously Hydrocarbons Finance Director, assumes the role on an interim basis from September 16, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, or premium is stated. This is a routine officer transition, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure constituting a special situation; no deal mechanics apply.
